t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Pick a number randomly, take a mental note of which colour has the bigger value. the values can change

vb_textbox.text: Pick a gnome of your choosing to begin with, as the game goes on you should take a note which gnome has the higher value to score bigger! Please note though that the amount can change throughout the game so after a while make sure to select a different colour gnome.
